name: Camo | Natural Leaf Wraps | Natural
description: Camo Natural Leaf Wraps are made from chamomile and mate plants, these are totally different from any other wrap! These slow-burning, self-rolling wraps pair perfectly with herbal blends. 5 wraps come in each resealable foil pack.
